test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
select the most appropriate idiom/phrase to fill in the blank and complete the sentence.

It was all _____________. He did not really mean what he said.

options.text: a storm in a tea cup

solution:
The correct answer is '**tongue in cheek**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom "**tongue in cheek**" means something said in a joking or ironic manner.
 
• In the given context, it implies that he did not really mean what he said and it was said humorously or not seriously.
 
• The other options do not fit the context:
 
 
• **Blue in the face**: Refers to persisting in an effort but to no avail.
 
• **Tuck in**: Refers to eating enthusiastically.
 
• **A storm in a tea cup**: Refers to making a big fuss about something trivial.
 
 

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *It was all tongue in cheek__. He did not really mean what he said.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Blue in the face (बेकार प्रयास)**: Used when someone tries very hard but it doesn’t yield results.
 
• **Tuck in (खाना)**: Refers to eating with enthusiasm or heartily.
 
• **A storm in a tea cup (छोटी बात पर बड़ा विवाद)**: Refers to making a big issue out of something trivial.
